subject: Intro: VP/CTO alignment - AcmeHealth / Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + VP/CTO intro (next steps)

Hi Samantha -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from the call:
- Goal: replace/augment AcmeHealth's customer support automation with a hosted + private deployment for PHI-sensitive flows.
- Top priorities: latency < 150ms P95 on short-turn prompts, token-cost predictability, SOC2 audit evidence for data retention.
- Key stakeholders: you (Head of Product), CTO (TBD), Security/Compliance, Procurement.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) to confirm architecture and SLAs so we can unblock procurement.
2) Technical deep-dive with Rachel (solutions review + quantization/training considerations).
3) Share a Mutual Action Plan and a draft SOW (attached).

Can you share 30-45 minutes next week for an intro with your CTO? If it helps, here are some windows we have available (all PT):
- Tue 6/13: 10:00-11:00 or 15:00-16:00
- Wed 6/14: 09:00-10:00 or 14:00-15:00

If neither works, please propose two times that are convenient and I'll coordinate on our side. I've attached a short mutual action plan so the execs can see the milestones and decision points.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_AcmeHealth.pdf (1 page)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + VP/CTO intro (next steps)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. Really helpful. I can do a 30-45 minute intro with our CTO but need to coordinate calendars. Can you do any of the following (PT)?
- Tue 6/13: 15:00-15:45 (best)
- Wed 6/14: 09:00-09:45

Also, can you include an engineering/solutions lead who can speak to latency/quantization? Please CC them on the invite.

I'll loop in Procurement once we have an exec alignment so they have the high-level view.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Product, AcmeHealth
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com

Perfect - thanks for the quick reply. We can do Tue 6/13 15:00-15:30 PT. I'm looping in Vivek (SVP Product) for exec alignment and Rachel (Solutions Engineer) for the technical context.

Vivek / Rachel - quick context: AcmeHealth is evaluating a hybrid hosted/private deployment for PHI-sensitive flows. They need executive confirmation on architecture choices (private control plane vs on-prem), SLA expectations, and a plan to satisfy SOC2 evidence for data retention. Samantha suggested Tue 6/13 15:00 PT for a 30-minute intro with their CTO - can you both make that? If not, propose an alternate 30-minute slot.

I've also added a 30-minute provisional invite and attached the MAP + draft SOW.

Thanks all -
Marissa
